description: This file defines a VideoRecorder class used for capturing and encoding video frames into a WebM file using ffmpeg, specifically for Chromium-based browser automation in Playwright.

classes.name: VideoRecorder
classes.description: A class responsible for recording video frames from a page, encoding them via ffmpeg, and managing the recording process lifecycle.

methods.name: launch
methods.description: Static method to create and initialize a VideoRecorder instance with specified page, ffmpeg path, and options.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Private constructor initializing the recorder with a page and ffmpeg path, setting up event listener for screencast frames.

methods.name: _launch
methods.description: Private method to configure and start the ffmpeg process with specific encoding options.

methods.name: writeFrame
methods.description: Method to enqueue a video frame for encoding, repeating frames based on duration to maintain timing.

methods.name: _sendFrames
methods.description: Private method to send all queued frames to ffmpeg.

methods.name: _sendFrame
methods.description: Private method to write a single frame buffer to ffmpeg stdin.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Method to stop recording, finalize the last frame, and close the ffmpeg process gracefully.
